quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Anderson Sr. on his unconventional basketball career path
quotes.excerpt: I had a long career that wasn't really a typical career. Journeyman, see a lot different settings.

quotes.speaker: Christian Anderson Sr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Anderson Sr. on the work required to reach elite levels
quotes.excerpt: It's an accumulation of all these things, living a lifestyle that makes you accomplish anything you want.
quotes.quote: It's not one particular trait that makes you work and get to this level. It's an accumulation of all these things, living a lifestyle that makes you accomplish anything you want.

quotes.speaker: Christian Anderson Sr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Anderson Sr. on Christian Anderson Jr.'s dual-processing ability
quotes.excerpt: I think what makes him special is his dual processing. Point guards usually just pass first.
quotes.quote: I think what makes him special is his dual processing. Point guards usually just pass first and shooting guards shoot first. I think he's a hybrid.

quotes.speaker: Grant McCasland
quotes.summary_phrase: Grant McCasland on Christian Anderson Jr.'s potential as a winner
quotes.excerpt: He's a winner in every way and tonight's just another step in that journey of winning.
quotes.quote: He's a winner in every way and tonight's just another step in that journey of winning. But his best days are ahead and I'm so excited for him to see another step in that journey happen tonight, but it's not the end, it's just the beginning.

quotes.speaker: Christian Anderson Sr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Anderson Sr. on the importance of emotional control in big games
quotes.excerpt: You have to have emotional control. So if you get too high, there's no different from an important game.
quotes.quote: You have to have emotional control. So if you get too high, there's no different from an important game. You might not be prepared for it.

quotes.speaker: Christian Anderson Sr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Anderson Sr. on the danger of unfulfilled potential
quotes.excerpt: I think the worst thing in the world is untapped or unfulfilled potential.
quotes.quote: I think the worst thing in the world is untapped or unfulfilled potential. He's worked and dedicated his life to the craft and so just fulfill your potential.
